bench_sqlserver_contact.query: SELECT id, name, email, city, created_at FROM contacts WHERE id = CAST({{id}} AS int);

bench_sqlserver_contacts.query: SELECT TOP (CAST({{take}} AS int)) id, name, email, city, created_at FROM contacts WHERE id > CAST({{after}} AS int) ORDER BY id;
